Residents faced similar flooding situations just weeks earlier.

title: Sam Altman ‘worried’ Microsoft, Amazon, Google, Meta and Nvidia could control AI

He emphasizes the idea that both society and AI systems must evolve together over time. Acknowledging the over-optimism in his past AI timeline projections, Altman points out how the economy's natural inertia can delay technological changes, allowing for a more gradual adjustment to new advancements.

title: Zuckerberg’s wife Priscilla Chan’s $125m school to shut after 10 yrs

While offering extensive support services, the school's academic results did not meet state benchmarks. The Chan Zuckerberg Initiative is providing financial support for the transition and educational savings accounts.

title: Maine's Sand Beach was once part of J.P. Morgan's 117-acre wedding gift

The land was donated in 1949 by Eleanor Morgan Satterlee in memory of her mother, Louisa, after the family property was badly damaged in the 1947 fire.

title: Alabama students turn old Christmas trees into Gulf Coast dune protection
content: Alabama's fragile sand dunes are being restored with discarded holiday trees, as students and volunteers team up to plant native vegetation along the coast. This innovative project marries sand trapping techniques with the introduction of native plants to stabilize the dunes. This effort not only protects essential infrastructure but also fosters crucial habitats for local wildlife, showcasing an eco-friendly method for coastal restoration and habitat recovery.

title: Johns Hopkins professor says he’s fine with students using AI to cheat

Teachers are now redesigning assignments to prevent AI reliance.  Some educators are even returning to handwritten work to discourage chatbot use.  Vigilance remains the key to identifying AI misuse in academic settings.

title: 'Does anyone actually care?' Sreejesh's scathing attack after India’s WC exit

With the men's squad falling short against Argentina, and the women's team drawing against Australia, neither team advanced to the World Cup semifinals. These disappointing results highlight the urgent need for reevaluation to enhance India's competitive edge in international hockey.

title: Coercion and bullying won't work: Iran's message to US during Munir meet

He stressed that coercion and bullying complicate diplomatic efforts and hinder progress. Munir's visit occurred amid heightened regional tensions and US sanctions. Both leaders emphasized cooperation for regional peace and stability.

title: Who is Danielle Belluomini? Meet 49ers owner Jed York’s longtime wife

A former sixth-grade science teacher, she married York in 2011, and they share two sons, Jaxon and Brixton. Belluomini has made occasional appearances at NFL events but largely avoids the spotlight. Their marriage drew renewed attention after York filed for divorce in May 2026, months before his Ohio arrest.

The rising valuation highlights the couple’s growing influence in women’s sports and comes as Patrick continues his recovery while preparing for his NFL return.

title: Travis Kelce makes young Chiefs fan’s training camp wish come true

Grey St. Louis left Kelce a handwritten note asking for his autograph, along with a jersey and photos. After weeks of waiting, Kelce signed everything on the final day of camp, leaving Grey and his family overwhelmed with joy. The family now plans to send Kelce friendship bracelets as a heartfelt gesture in return.

title: Hits on government sites during Operation Sindoor: NIA begins probe
content:
NIA searches five states in cyberterror case over attempted DDoS attacks on govt websites during Operation Sindoor

NEW DELHI: NIA conducted searches at five locations in Maharashtra, Gujarat, Telangana, Bihar and Delhi Monday in connection with attempted distributed denial of service attacks against govt websites during Operation Sindoor. The accused in the Gujarat cyber terrorism case - registered on June 25, 2025 - had attempted sophisticated DDoS attacks against 54 websites of govt entities, targeting critical computer resources and CII . Two accused have already been arrested. During probe, suspects who had provided support and assistance to the accused were identified through technical analysis. Searches were conducted and digital devices and documents containing incriminating material related to hacking activities were seized. The suspects were examined regarding their association with the accused in custody.

End of Article
